Maybe they need no surrounding quotes. I gave {"mapped_rxn": "...", "template_id": 19640}. That's fine.

But they said "No actions to execute. This is due to parsing error or missing action in the response." Means maybe they didn't detect <final_answer> tag correctly because of extra spaces or newline? I used newline after <final_answer>. Should be fine. Might need to ensure no extra whitespace before tags. Provide exactly.
